topics.scope: 自 2025–26 学年第一学期起；使用前须查具体考核说明。

claims.text: The syllabus must state GenAI policy for relevant assessed components. An individual assessment may override it when communicated with the assessment specifications.

evidence.quote: Starting Term 1, 2025-2026, every course must include an explicit declaration of AI usage policies in a dedicated section of the syllabus with the heading Generative AI Use Policy.
evidence.title: Policies on Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
evidence.location: IV.c Syllabus; physical PDF page 5

evidence.location: IV.c Assessment exception; physical PDF page 6

topics.evidenceScope: From Term 1, 2025–26; read the specific assessment instructions before using GenAI.

topics.title: 考试
topics.summary: 考试是否允许使用取决于已公布的考核规则；披露不能使被禁止的使用变为合规。
topics.scope: 适用于包括考试在内的单项考核限制；不推断通用考试许可。

claims.text: Exam permission depends on the communicated assessment policy; disclosure does not make a prohibited use acceptable.

evidence.location: IV.c Assessment exception; physical PDF page 6

topics.title: 披露
topics.summary: 须披露工具及其对成果的影响程度；已在成果中说明，或活动要求已清楚表明该使用时，无须另附独立声明。
topics.scope: 适用于师生；课程新增披露要求须随活动说明妥善告知。

claims.text: Disclose the tool and how much it influenced the output. A separate statement is unnecessary when disclosure is already embedded or the specified activity makes the use obvious.

evidence.quote: For both faculty and students, the use of generative AI in the production of any material, presentation, or submission, must be accompanied by a written disclosure statement.
evidence.title: Policies on Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
evidence.location: IV.b Disclosure; physical PDF page 4

claims.text: Disclose the tool and how much it influenced the output. A separate statement is unnecessary when disclosure is already embedded or the specified activity makes the use obvious.

evidence.quote:
A separate disclosure statement is not required anymore if the disclosure is already
           embedded within the output itself (e.g., if the generative AI was used as part of a research
           methodology, and this was already explained in the Methodology section of the
           manuscript). Likewise, a separate disclosure statement is not required anymore if the type


                                 of generative AI use is already obvious from the specifications of the activity (e.g., the
                                 activity requires students to use generative AI for a specific purpose).

                            •
evidence.title: Policies on Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
evidence.location: Disclosure requirements; physical PDF pages 4–5

topics.evidenceScope: Faculty and students; additional course disclosure requirements must be properly communicated with the activity specifications.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 个人或高度敏感信息、校内文件、专有研究及保密信息均不应分享给生成式 AI 服务。
topics.scope: 上述数据类别的原文为 should never；研究参与者数据另有知情同意和匿名化条件。

claims.text: Personal or highly sensitive information, internal university documents, proprietary research and confidential information should never be shared with GenAI services.

evidence.quote:

evidence.location: Data privacy; physical PDF page 9; physical PDF page 9

topics.evidenceScope: The policy uses “should never” for these data categories; research participant data has additional consent and anonymisation conditions.

topics.title: 机构工具
topics.summary: 政策中的产品名称是示例，不能据此认定学校采购、免费使用或所有考核均获批准。
topics.scope: 冻结的公开工具集合中未列独立机构工具记录；不据此断言学校没有工具。
topics.evidenceGap: No independently published institutional tool records were found in the frozen public tool collection. The policy names tools as examples but does not establish a university licence, free access or universal assessment approval.
topics.evidenceScope: No independently published institutional tool records were found in the frozen public tool collection.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 研究参与者数据如交由生成式 AI 处理，须写入知情同意、始终匿名化，并在必要时取得伦理批准；发表场所的披露要求也须遵守。
topics.scope: 限科研数据及发表场所要求，不构成上传保密研究的通用许可。

claims.text: Research participant data use must be declared in informed consent, anonymised, and ethically approved when necessary; venue-specific disclosure requirements also apply.

evidence.quote: In research, if any participant or subject data is to be processed by generative AI services, this must be indicated in the informed consent form in the data collection process. Furthermore, such data must always be anonymized, and ethical approval must be secured when necessary.
evidence.title: Policies on Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
evidence.location: IV.e Research; physical PDF page 9

claims.text: Research participant data use must be declared in informed consent, anonymised, and ethically approved when necessary; venue-specific disclosure requirements also apply.

evidence.quote:
In research, students and faculty must comply with the generative AI disclosure
                                 requirements of the target venues for publication.
evidence.title: Policies on Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
evidence.location: Disclosure requirements; physical PDF page 5; physical PDF page 5

topics.evidenceScope: Research data and publication-specific conditions; this is not blanket permission to upload confidential research.

claims.text: Teachers must communicate assessment-specific overrides and any extra disclosure requirements when releasing the activity specifications.

evidence.quote:
Instructors may include additional disclosure requirements for students in specific course
                                 activities or assessments. These must be properly communicated to the students upon the
                                 release of the activity or assessment specifications. Examples of additional disclosure
                                 requirements are: (1) disclosure of relevant interaction logs of the student with the
                                 generative AI (e.g., prompts used, response of the AI), and (2) compliance with a specific
                                 format for citation (e.g., APA4, MLE5, or a custom format for the course).

                            •

evidence.location: Disclosure requirements; physical PDF page 5; physical PDF page 5

                                 format for citation (e.g., APA4, MLE5, or a custom format for the course).

security_procurement:live-dlsu_pdf-09.text: GenAI use remains subject to existing privacy, intellectual-property and research-ethics rules; a separate procurement approval process was not established.
security_procurement:live-dlsu_pdf-09.scope: The policy does not itself approve every provider or every data use.

evidence.quote: In research, if any participant or subject data is to be processed by generative AI services, this must be indicated in the informed consent form in the data collection process. Furthermore, such data must always be anonymized, and ethical approval must be secured when necessary.
evidence.location: IV.e Research; physical PDF page 9

coursework.en: The syllabus must state GenAI policy for relevant assessed components. An individual assessment may override it when communicated with the assessment specifications.
coursework.zh: 教学大纲须说明相关考核项目的生成式 AI 规则；单项考核可在发布要求时明确覆盖默认规则。
coursework.meaningEn: From Term 1, 2025–26; read the specific assessment instructions before using GenAI.
coursework.meaningZh: 自 2025–26 学年第一学期起；使用前须查具体考核说明。

exams.en: Exam permission depends on the communicated assessment policy; disclosure does not make a prohibited use acceptable.
exams.zh: 考试是否允许使用取决于已公布的考核规则；披露不能使被禁止的使用变为合规。
exams.meaningEn: Assessment-specific restrictions, including exams; no universal exam permission is inferred.
exams.meaningZh: 适用于包括考试在内的单项考核限制；不推断通用考试许可。

disclosure.en: Disclose the tool and how much it influenced the output. A separate statement is unnecessary when disclosure is already embedded or the specified activity makes the use obvious.
disclosure.zh: 须披露工具及其对成果的影响程度；已在成果中说明，或活动要求已清楚表明该使用时，无须另附独立声明。
disclosure.meaningEn: Faculty and students; additional course disclosure requirements must be properly communicated with the activity specifications.
disclosure.meaningZh: 适用于师生；课程新增披露要求须随活动说明妥善告知。

privacy_data.en: Personal or highly sensitive information, internal university documents, proprietary research and confidential information should never be shared with GenAI services.
privacy_data.zh: 个人或高度敏感信息、校内文件、专有研究及保密信息均不应分享给生成式 AI 服务。
privacy_data.meaningEn: The policy uses “should never” for these data categories; research participant data has additional consent and anonymisation conditions.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 上述数据类别的原文为 should never；研究参与者数据另有知情同意和匿名化条件。

approved_tools.en: The policy names tools as examples but does not establish a university licence, free access or universal assessment approval.
approved_tools.zh: 政策中的产品名称是示例，不能据此认定学校采购、免费使用或所有考核均获批准。
approved_tools.meaningEn: No independently published institutional tool records were found in the frozen public tool collection.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 冻结的公开工具集合中未列独立机构工具记录；不据此断言学校没有工具。

research_publication.en: Research participant data use must be declared in informed consent, anonymised, and ethically approved when necessary; venue-specific disclosure requirements also apply.
research_publication.zh: 研究参与者数据如交由生成式 AI 处理，须写入知情同意、始终匿名化，并在必要时取得伦理批准；发表场所的披露要求也须遵守。
research_publication.meaningEn: Research data and publication-specific conditions; this is not blanket permission to upload confidential research.
research_publication.meaningZh: 限科研数据及发表场所要求，不构成上传保密研究的通用许可。

academic_integrity.en: Using GenAI in a prohibited way can constitute dishonesty even if disclosed. Detector output alone cannot justify rejecting work or imposing a grade penalty.
academic_integrity.zh: 即使披露，违反考核禁用规则仍可能构成学术不诚实；不能仅凭检测器结果拒收作业或扣分。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: GenAI-related dishonesty; separate plagiarism-detection functions are not conflated with AI detection.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 限生成式 AI 相关不诚实；不将抄袭比对与 AI 检测混同。

teaching_guidance.en: Teachers must communicate assessment-specific overrides and any extra disclosure requirements when releasing the activity specifications.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教师须在发布活动说明时明确告知考核覆盖规则及额外披露要求。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Course and activity instructions; no automatic misconduct finding follows from a detector flag.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 适用于课程和具体活动说明；检测器标记不等于自动判定违规。

security_procurement.en: GenAI use remains subject to existing privacy, intellectual-property and research-ethics rules; a separate procurement approval process was not established.
security_procurement.zh: 生成式 AI 使用仍须遵守既有隐私、知识产权和研究伦理要求；本次未核实独立采购审批流程。
security_procurement.meaningEn: The policy does not itself approve every provider or every data use.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 本政策本身不批准所有服务商或数据用途。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Disclose AI use, preserving the exceptions to a separate statement.
do.zh: 披露 AI 使用，同时保留无须另附独立声明的例外。

dont.en: Do not use GenAI in a way the assessment prohibits, even if disclosed.
dont.zh: 即使披露，也不得按考核禁止的方式使用生成式 AI。
